This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Announcement" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|orange]] skin, large [[nose]]s, and low-set [[mouth]]s.<ref name="Announcement" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[5 BBY]], a member of this species was enjoying the [[Niamos Beach|beaches]] of the [[planet]] [[Niamos]] with another [[alien]] individual when [[Cassian Jeron Andor]] was wrongly arrested by the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Announcement" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[Announcement|seventh episode]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', directed by [[Benjamin Caron]].<ref name="Announcement" />
